map.由动压、升力系数与面积求升力 使用指南: Lift from Dynamic Pressure, Lift Coefficient and Area User Guide
map.输入空气密度 ρ、速度 v、升力系数 C_L 与机翼面积 A，求升力。: Enter air density ρ, speed v, lift coefficient C_L and wing area A to get lift.
map.升力方程 L=½ρv²·C_L·A，用于配平与性能计算。: Lift equation L = ½ρv²·C_L·A, used for trim and performance calculation.
map.对比不同 C_L（襟翼放下增大）下的可用升力，评估起飞着陆性能。: Compare available lift at different C_L (raised by lowering flaps) to assess takeoff and landing performance.
map.已知需平衡的重量，反推所需速度或 C_L。: Given the weight to be balanced, back out the required speed or C_L.
map.：空气密度 ρ=1.225、速度 v=80 m/s、升力系数 C_L=1.2、面: : air density ρ = 1.225, speed v = 80 m/s, lift coefficient C_L = 1.2, area A = 30 m². L = ½ × 1.225 × 80² × 1.2 × 30 = ½ × 1.225 × 6400 × 1.2 × 30 = 140,688 N ≈ 140.7 kN. Balancing a weight of the same order gives level flight.
map.起飞时怎么用升力方程？: How is the lift equation used at takeoff?
map.起飞滑跑到离地速度 v，需 L≥W。通过增大 C_L（襟翼）或增速使 L 追上重: On the takeoff roll to liftoff speed v, L must be at least W. Raise C_L (flaps) or speed so L catches up with weight; stall speed Vs is exactly the lowest safe speed at L = W (see the stall speed tool).
map.ρ 用哪个高度的值？: Which height should ρ be taken at?
map.用飞行高度的实际空气密度，海平面 ρ≈1.225、巡航高度显著下降。密度低则同速: Use the actual air density at flight altitude: sea level ρ ≈ 1.225, falling markedly at cruise altitude. Low density means less lift at the same speed, needing higher speed or larger C_L (larger wing area) to compensate.
